mapper.sql: e.evaluation_id, e.application_id, app.project_name, app.status AS application_status, u.company_name, a.title AS announcement_title, e.evaluator_user_id, ev.user_name AS evaluator_name, e.quantitative_score, e.qualitative_score, e.total_score, e.eval_comment, e.status, e.assigned_at, e.evaluated_at

FROM evaluation e INNER JOIN application app ON e.application_id = app.application_id INNER JOIN announcement a ON app.announcement_id = a.announcement_id INNER JOIN users u ON app.company_user_id = u.user_id INNER JOIN users ev ON e.evaluator_user_id = ev.user_id
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM evaluation WHERE application_id = #{applicationId} AND status <> 'COMPLETED'
mapper.update: UPDATE evaluation SET quantitative_score = #{quantitativeScore}, qualitative_score = #{qualitativeScore}, total_score = #{totalScore}, eval_comment = #{evalComment}, status = 'COMPLETED', evaluated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE evaluation_id = #{evaluationId} AND evaluator_user_id = #{evaluatorUserId} AND status = 'ASSIGNED'
